run_UpdateClang: run the script to download and unpack prebuilt clang binaries for the current platform
run_DownloadUrl: run a URL download with progress dots and automatic retry on failure
run_DownloadAndUnpack: run a download and extract a gzipped tar archive to a specified output directory
run_RmTree: run a recursive directory deletion that handles read-only files by chmodding first
run_WriteStampFile: run a stamp file write to record the current clang package version
